what_to_do.en: Tap the blend word that replaces blank.
what_to_do.ko: blank 자리에 알맞은 세 글자 자음 블렌드 낱말을 누르세요.

stages.choice_rule: Four lowercase whole words from the roots list. Exactly one choice starts with str, spr, scr, squ, or thr and is the only word that completes the stem. Put that word at a varying answer index. The other three choices follow the roots distractor rule for the item tier. The stem uses blank once as the missing word.

gold_items.stem: My duck swims in the blank.
A loud blank woke the baby.
My shoe has a loose blank.
We blank the little green plant.
Please blank the ripe orange now.
<NAME> will blank the little ball to me.
Please blank the jam on my bread today.

roots: Write four different whole-word choices and exactly one right answer.
Put the lowercase word blank once in the stem where the missing word belongs.
The right word starts with str, spr, scr, squ, or thr and is on the roots list.
The right word is the only choice that makes a true, sensible sentence.
Tier 1 distractors are ordinary words that do not fit and are not three-letter blends.
Tier 2 distractors are two-letter blend words that look a little like the answer but do not fit.
Tier 3 distractors are other three-letter blend words that do not fit the sentence.
Do not use blank as a choice, and do not use a second choice that could also be correct.
Tiers 1 and 2 use the explain key for the answer onset: str_blend, spr_blend, scr_blend, squ_blend, or thr_blend.
Tier 3 uses the explain key blend_fits, because several choices are three-letter blend words.
Keep sentences in the kid world of school, home, food, pets, play, family, and weather.

tier_rules.1: Short stems of four to six words about home, pets, or play. The answer is a common blend word, and the other choices are ordinary words that do not fit.
tier_rules.2: Grade-level stems of about six words. Distractors are two-letter blend words that share letters with the answer but do not complete the sentence.
tier_rules.3: Stems of seven or more words. Distractors are other three-letter blend words, so only sentence meaning shows which word is right.
